sentences.text:
Niranjan Mandal @ Niranjan Kumar Mandal vs The State Of
Jharkhand .... Opposite ... on 8 September, 2025

Author: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
Bench: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
 2025:Jhhc:27045
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand, Ranchi
 A.B.A. No. 5074 of 2025
 ----
Niranjan Mandal @ Niranjan Kumar Mandal, aged about 18 years, son of Ashok Mandal, resident of
village - Ghosko, Po - Budhudih, Ps - Ahilyapur, District - Giridih .... Petitioner
-- Versus --
The State of Jharkhand .... Opposite Party
----
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi

--- 
For the Petitioner :- Mr. Kaushal Kishor Mishra, Advocate For the State :- Mr. Shailendra Kr.
Tiwari, Advocate ----
05/08.09.2025 Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner as well as the learned counsel appearing for the State.
2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Ahilyapur P.S. Case No.47 of 2023,
for the alleged offences registered under Sections 411, 414, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120(B) and 34 of Indian Penal Code, Section 66(B), 66(C) and 66(D) of I.T. Act, pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II- cum-Special Judge (Cyber Crime), Giridih.
3.
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has earlier moved before this Court in ABA No.4509 of 2024 which was dismissed as withdrawn by order dated 15.04.2025.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 He submits that thereafter another co-accused arising out of the same FIR in identical situation has been granted anticipatory bail by this Court in ABA Nos.2660 of 2025 by order dated 08.08.2025.

He 2025:JHHC:27045 submits that earlier proclamation under Section 82 of Cr.P.C. has been issued against the petitioner and the said has been set aside by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Cr.M.P. No.2362 of 2024.
He submits that the petitioner has got no criminal antecedent and that has been stated in supplementary counter affidavit filed by the State in the earlier ABA.

4. Learned counsel appearing for the State opposes the prayer and submits that earlier the petition was dismissed as withdrawn and in view of that the anticipatory bail of the petitioner may kindly be dismissed.

5. It is an admitted position that the petitioner has earlier moved before this Court in ABA No.4509 of 2024 which has been dismissed as withdrawn by order dated 15.04.2025 and thereafter another co-accused has been granted anticipatory bail by order dated 08.08.2025

and in such circumstance the second anticipatory bail can be maintained and the petitioner has got no criminal antecedent that has been stated in supplementary counter affidavit filed by the State in the earlier ABA which has been dismissed as withdrawn and there are general and omnibus allegations against the petitioner and the name of the petitioner has come on the confessional statement, I am inclined to provide anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

6. Accordingly, the petitioner, above named, is hereby directed to surrender before the learned Court within three weeks from 2025:JHHC:27045 today, and in the event of his surrender/arrest,
the petitioner, above named, shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand), with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II-cum-Special Judge (Cyber Crime), Giridih in connection with Ahilyapur P.S. Case No.47 of 2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 482(2) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Sangam/
